data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: Durable storage is bounded by the workload byte ceiling; it is alarm-only because the data is not regenerable.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces are declared from observed canonical scenario directories; external resource databases are not claimed by this scenario.

service.name: prompt-manager
service.description: File-based prompt storage and management tool with API access and web interface for organizing AI prompts

linux.evidence: Linux module and heartbeat contract tests; host qualification is not claimed

descriptors.label: Prompt Manager experiment receipt signing key ring
descriptors.description: Versioned Ed25519 signing keys retained by the native Vrooli credential authority. The active private key is never stored in scenario files or environment variables.

agent-manager.description: Executes heartbeat runs through Prompt Manager's declared role-only profiles. Heartbeat system degrades when unavailable.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Scheduled heartbeat runs are skipped until agent-manager is available

source-ledger.description: Team corpus ledger: the API registers one scope per team at boot and reads team knowledge through it.
source-ledger.degraded_behavior: Team knowledge features are unavailable until source-ledger is reachable

vrooli-events.description: Platform event bus the API publishes team and heartbeat events to.
vrooli-events.degraded_behavior: Events are not published until vrooli-events is reachable

qdrant.description: Vector database for AI-powered semantic search (stores skill embeddings)
qdrant.degraded_behavior: Semantic search features fall back to file-backed lookup only

ollama.description: Local Ollama roles for AI search embeddings and prompt testing
ollama.degraded_behavior: Local embedding generation and prompt-evaluation flows are unavailable

usage.reason: Declared 2026-09-02: the usage role is served by the pack skill `skill-authoring` at store/skills/packs/core/skill-authoring/SKILL.md, whose programs are prompt-manager.skill-set-read, prompt-manager.meta-optimization-reads, and prompt-manager.vision-walk-prep; the skillRole source pattern accepts only skills/<id>/SKILL.md, which prompt-manager does not ship.

improve.reason: Guide setpoint is served by meta-optimization-manager coverage until `prompt-manager skill-set validate` ships (declared 2026-09-02).
